title: Iran Blockade Costs Are Draining America’s Global Military Power
gist: The US naval blockade of Iran, Trump's preferred coercive tool, is stretching the American military to its limit, exhausting troops and consuming high-tech weapons built for a China conflict, weakening Washington's position in Asia.

insights.claim: A US naval blockade has become President Trump's tool of choice to force Iran into submission, but it is stretching the American military to its limit and exhausting troops.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: Sustained blockade operations imply elevated readiness costs and maintenance/munitions demand for US forces.
insights.quote: a naval blockade is proving to be his tool of choice
